1. Introduction

This Privacy Policy explains how YonoappDex handles information when you browse our app index and articles. We keep data collection to a minimum, and we aim to comply with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act) and the Information Technology Act, 2000.

2. What We Do Not Collect

You do not need an account or to give personal details to use this site. We do not ask for or process the following:

  • Accounts or profiles: we have no registration, login, or user profiles.
  • Financial or KYC data: no bank details, UPI IDs, card numbers, wallet balances, Aadhaar, PAN, or KYC documents.
  • Device files: viewing our pages does not give us access to your storage, contacts, SMS, or media.

3. Cookies, Browser Storage and Security Technology

  • No advertising trackers: we do not use behavioural retargeting pixels, cross-site tracking cookies, or advertising profiling scripts.
  • Security cookies from Cloudflare: our site is protected by Cloudflare. To tell real visitors from automated bots and to stop attacks, Cloudflare may set strictly necessary security cookies in your browser, such as __cf_bm (bot detection) and cf_clearance (set after a security check is passed). These are used for security, not advertising.
  • Local storage on your device: we use browser storage to remember choices such as your theme preference and that you acknowledged our 18+ and exit-gate notices. This stays in your browser and is not used to build a profile of you. It is cleared when you clear your browser data.
  • Your control: you can block or delete cookies and local storage in your browser settings. Some security checks may then not work as intended, and you may see the notices again.

4. Technical Data, Security Logs and Service Providers

We use Cloudflare and our hosting provider to deliver and protect this website. When you visit, these providers receive standard technical data, such as your IP address, browser type, device and operating system, the page requested, and referring URL. An IP address may be personal data.

  • Purpose: this data is used to deliver pages, detect bots and attacks, and keep the site secure and available.
  • Retention: security and server logs are kept by these providers for periods set by their own policies. We do not use this data to identify individual visitors or to build advertising profiles.
  • Location: our providers may process data on servers outside India.
  • Aggregate statistics: any traffic figures we use (for example, page views on an app profile) are aggregated and do not identify you.

5. Emails and Grievances You Send Us

We receive identifiable contact details only when you email support@yonoappdex.com, for example to report a broken link, a security issue, or an IP concern.

  • Purpose limitation: we use your email address and message only to investigate and reply to your inquiry or grievance.
  • No sale or sharing: we do not sell, rent, or trade your email address, and we do not share it with game developers or marketing agencies. We may disclose it where required by law. Once your matter is resolved, the record is archived or deleted in line with applicable legal retention requirements.

6. Third-Party Sites and Apps

Our privacy responsibility ends at our own website. Clicking an outbound link shows an exit notice that you are leaving YonoappDex. After that, the external developer's privacy policy applies. Third-party gaming apps often require phone number registration, KYC, device permissions, and financial disclosures. We do not control how external developers collect or use your data, so please read their privacy policy before registering or downloading.

7. Children and Minors

YonoappDex is intended for adults aged 18 and older. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 18. If we find that a minor has sent personal details to our support email, we will delete that correspondence and the sender's contact address.

8. Your Rights Under the DPDP Act, 2023

Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, if you have contacted us by email you may ask us to confirm whether we hold your email record, correct inaccurate details, or erase your correspondence from our support system. You may also use our grievance process. Write to our Grievance Officer:

Grievance Officer: [Govardhan Das], YonoappDex
Email: support@yonoappdex.com

9. Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy to reflect changes in our technology, our service providers, or Indian data protection law. Updates will be published on this page with a new date.

1. Our Commitment to Editorial Integrity

Our first responsibility is to the public. The web is full of misleading promotional blogs, disguised ads, and counterfeit download portals, so we operate as an independent, non-commercial software encyclopedia. This policy governs how we research, categorise, write, and maintain every app profile. Our aim is simple: factual, objective, and unmanipulated information, so users understand an application before they interact with external developers.

2. Non-Commercial and Zero-Commission Policy

When a site earns money for every download or deposit, its reviews tend to become sales pitches. We avoid that conflict of interest:

  • No referral or affiliate revenue: we do not take part in referral programs, cost-per-acquisition networks, revenue sharing, or affiliate schemes with any studio or operator.
  • No paid placements: developers cannot pay to be listed, featured, ranked higher, or described favourably.
  • No gifts or favours: our editors and administrators may not accept money, credits, gifts, or favours from developers in exchange for inclusion or for suppressing negative safety updates.

3. How We Document Apps

Our editors do not write subjective "hands-on gameplay reviews" and do not create player accounts or wager real money on indexed platforms. We use an Observational Synthesis approach:

  • Public sources: every profile is compiled from verifiable public records, such as developer documentation, published rulebooks, version changelogs, interface layouts, and technical details like file size, system requirements, and permission declarations.
  • Neutral tone: we avoid hype and promises such as "easy winnings" or "guaranteed payouts". Text is analytical and descriptive.
  • No security certification: documenting an app's public specifications is not a source-code audit or a guarantee of the developer's reliability.

4. Risk Transparency and Labelling

In line with consumer transparency principles under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 and the advertising standards of the Advertising Standards Council of India (ASCI), we apply these labelling rules:

  • Clear separation: every entry must distinguish Non-Monetary Casual Simulations (free-to-play) from Real-Money Gaming / Skill-Based Platforms (deposits and monetary stakes).
  • Risk shown up front: whenever an app has real-money mechanics, the profile carries prominent 18+ advisories, financial loss warnings, and a notice about legal restrictions, next to the technical breakdown.

5. Anti-Phishing and Source Verification

Popular "Yono" app names are often hijacked by clones that steal user data. Before publishing an outbound link, we follow this protocol:

  • Origin checks: we cross-check domain history and publisher releases so the link points to the developer's official portal and not to a mirror or modded APK site.
  • Point-in-time notice: external developers control their own servers, so our exit warning states that our check applies when the link is published and that leaving our site carries independent third-party risk.

6. Corrections, Updates, and Delisting

  • Updates: when a developer makes a major change to an app, we update its profile.
  • Safety over traffic: even if an app brings high search traffic, we will remove its outbound link and add a public safety warning if we verify that the developer introduced malware, phishing traps, or fraudulent mechanics. Safety overrides traffic metrics.

7. Editorial Independence and Contact

Final decisions on categories, classification, and safety warnings rest with the independent administration of YonoappDex. To report a factual error or an ethical concern about a listing, contact:

Grievance Officer: [Govardhan Das], YonoappDex
Email: support@yonoappdex.com

settings.responsibility_content:
1. Our Commitment to Player Safety

YonoappDex catalogs the Yono application ecosystem, from casual arcade and board games to card games and platforms involving real money. Because some apps involve financial stakes and variable rewards, we believe education must go beyond technical details. This charter explains the psychological, mathematical, and financial risks of digital gaming, in line with consumer awareness principles under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 and the risk-disclosure standards of the Advertising Standards Council of India (ASCI).

Real-money online gaming is prohibited or restricted under Indian law, including the Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025. Do not use any app that is unlawful where you live.

2. Understanding Skill, Chance, and Financial Risk

  • Entertainment, not employment: gaming apps are leisure. They are never a reliable way to earn income, solve debt, or build wealth.
  • House edge and variance: even in games described as "games of skill", short-term results are heavily influenced by statistical variance, random card distribution, and platform fees (rake). No strategy guarantees profit.
  • Real-money risk: any money you deposit is exposed to total loss.

3. Principles of Safe and Responsible Play

If you are 18 or older and choose to use gaming apps outside our directory, we strongly advise these personal limits:

  • Set a strict budget: only use money you can afford to lose entirely, without affecting living costs, rent, family, education, or savings.
  • Never chase losses: trying to win back money by depositing more is the most dangerous trap. Walk away when your limit is reached.
  • Set time limits: apps are designed to keep you engaged. Set alarms and take regular breaks.
  • Never borrow to play: no credit cards, loans, overdrafts, payday advances, or money from friends and family.
  • Avoid emotional or impaired play: do not play when stressed, depressed, anxious, under financial pressure, or under the influence of alcohol or medication.

4. Digital Security and Device Hygiene

We check outbound links when an app is indexed, but staying safe on your own device takes active care:

  • Separate accounts: never link your main savings account or salary UPI ID to third-party gaming apps. Use a low-balance secondary account.
  • Check permissions: when installing apps outside official stores, review the permissions requested. A card or arcade game does not need your SMS inbox, call logs, or contacts.
  • Beware of "guaranteed win" scams: Telegram groups, WhatsApp channels, or YouTube videos selling "hacked Yono APKs", "colour prediction predictors", or "guaranteed winning tricks" are fraudulent traps designed to steal your money and compromise your device.

5. Warning Signs of Problem Gaming

Compulsive habits develop gradually. You or someone you know may be affected if you notice:

  • Spending more and more time and money to feel the same excitement.
  • Feeling restless, irritable, or anxious when cutting down or stopping.
  • Hiding gaming activity or losses from family, spouses, or colleagues.
  • Neglecting work, studies, sleep, or relationships because of gaming.
  • Repeatedly failing to keep your own deposit or time limits.

6. Self-Exclusion and Practical Steps

YonoappDex does not operate gaming servers or manage player accounts, so we cannot block your access to external apps or freeze your accounts. You can take these steps yourself:

  1. Request self-exclusion: contact the app's customer support and ask for permanent account closure.
  2. Uninstall and block: remove gaming apps, clear saved logins, and use digital wellbeing locks or app-blocking software such as Gamban or BetBlocker.
  3. Financial cooling-off: disable UPI auto-pay mandates and lower daily transaction limits in your banking app.

7. Protection of Minors

Real-money gaming is unlawful for anyone under 18. Parents and guardians should:

  • Secure phones and tablets with biometric or PIN locks, and never share UPI PINs or banking passwords with children.
  • Use parental controls such as Google Family Link or Apple Screen Time to block installation of unknown apps (sideloading) and restrict adult websites.

8. Mental Health and Addiction Support (India)

If you or someone in your family is struggling with compulsive gaming, financial distress, or emotional overwhelm, free and confidential support is available:

  • Tele-MANAS (Ministry of Health & Family Welfare): call 14416 or 1800-891-4416, 24/7, toll-free, in 20+ Indian languages.
  • KIRAN Mental Health Helpline (Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment): call 1800-599-0019, 24/7, toll-free.
  • NIMHANS SHUT Clinic (Bengaluru): Service for Healthy Use of Technology, offering clinical help for technology and gaming addiction.
  • Vandrevala Foundation Crisis Helpline: call +91 9999 666 555, 24/7, confidential.

9. Contact Our Safety Desk

If an indexed app refuses to honour self-exclusion requests or uses predatory mechanics against vulnerable users, please report it so we can review and remove the outbound link:

Grievance Officer: [Govardhan Das], YonoappDex
Email: support@yonoappdex.com

Last updated: 1 November 2026
settings.about_content:
The Origin and Our Mission

The digital landscape for mobile entertainment, especially the fast-growing ecosystem of "Yono" applications, is highly unorganised. Every day, people searching for casual card games, arcade titles, and skill-based platforms meet a chaotic mix of unverified websites, misleading information, and counterfeit platforms.

YonoappDex was created to bring clarity and structure to this space. We saw the need for a clean, reliable, and objective digital encyclopedia. Our mission is to map the Yono application ecosystem and break down complex platforms, so users can understand an app's features, rules, and structure before they engage with it.

The "Dex" Concept: What We Do

"Dex" stands for Index. YonoappDex is an independent informational directory and analytical hub, a library of software data. We take the scattered and often confusing information around these apps and organise it into clean, factual, easy-to-read profiles. By clearly separating casual free-to-play apps from real-money platforms, we remove guesswork and help users make informed decisions.

Our Observational Indexing Approach

To stay objective, we use an "Observational Indexing" model. Our team works as digital archivists, not game testers. We build app profiles by combining public developer documentation, version release notes, published rulebooks, and open technical details. Each listing aims to describe the application's intended design, without subjective gameplay bias or personal opinion.

Independent and Non-Commercial

Real transparency requires editorial independence. YonoappDex is a non-commercial directory. We do not accept paid developer sponsorships, sell premium rankings, or earn from promotional partnerships. Our priority is accurate public information, with user safety and education first. Read our Editorial Standards & Ethics Policy for the full details.

The Informational Bridge

We are an information platform, not an app distribution network. YonoappDex does not host, store, or distribute executable files (.apk, .xapk, or .ipa). When users want to explore an app further, we provide outbound reference links to the official developer's portal, checked when the app is listed. This helps users avoid phishing traps and reach genuine sources, and they are told clearly that they are moving to an external site.

Commitment to Digital Transparency

YonoappDex is built on the principle that users have the right to know what they are downloading. By breaking down complex apps, keeping our independence, and being open about how links work, we aim to provide a safe, structured, and trustworthy place to explore the digital app world.

Last updated: 1 November 2026

settings.report_removal_content:
1. Purpose and Legal Framework

YonoappDex is an informational directory. We check each outbound link to an official developer portal when an application is indexed, but third-party apps change. Developers may alter their code, abandon domains, introduce predatory mechanics, or let certificates expire after our review.

This policy gives users, security researchers, intellectual property owners, and authorities a clear way to flag problematic listings. It is designed to follow Section 79 of the Information Technology Act, 2000 and Rule 3(2) of the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021.

2. How to Report an App

  • Channel A: On-page "Report / Flag App" button. Every application profile has this button. No account is needed. Select the issue category, describe the problem, and submit it to our moderation queue.
  • Channel B: Email. For intellectual property notices, developer removal requests, regulatory orders, or reports with screenshots and transaction logs, write to support@yonoappdex.com.

3. Grounds for Reporting

  1. Malware, phishing, or domain hijacking: a link no longer leads to the official developer portal, triggers unverified .apk downloads, injects spyware, or has been taken over by a phishing clone.
  2. Fraudulent operator behaviour: credible reports from several users that an operator is freezing legitimate withdrawals, manipulating game mechanics, or running a deposit scam.
  3. Legal violations: evidence that an indexed platform is breaking Indian law on real-money gaming or is not enforcing 18+ age verification.
  4. Factual or technical inaccuracies: outdated versions, changed rules, defunct apps, or broken links returning 404 or server errors.
  5. Intellectual property infringement: requests from verified publishers, trademark holders, or authorised representatives under the Copyright Act, 1957 or the Trade Marks Act, 1999 seeking correction or removal of brand details.

4. Information Needed for Legal or IP Takedowns

Safety flags made with the on-page button only need an issue category and a description. Formal legal or IP requests sent by email must include the following, so we can prevent abuse by competitors:

  • The exact URL(s) on YonoappDex where the application profile appears.
  • Identification of the trademark, copyrighted work, or law allegedly violated.
  • Documentary proof of ownership, such as trademark registration certificates, domain ownership records, or authorisation letters.
  • A statement that the information in the notice is accurate and given in good faith.

5. Review and Delisting Process

Reports are reviewed independently of any commercial interest. See our Editorial Standards & Ethics Policy.

  1. Logging and triage: each report is logged. Malware, phishing, and fraudulent-withdrawal reports are prioritised.
  2. Technical check: we inspect the reported link for domain changes, broken SSL certificates, or suspicious redirects.
  3. Link removal: if the app or link is confirmed unsafe, fraudulent, or broken, we disable the outbound link.
  4. Outcome:
    • IP or developer requests: the listing is corrected or removed as requested, where the request is verified.
    • Confirmed scam or malware apps: we keep the page, remove the outbound link, and show a Red Public Safety Warning Banner.

6. Response Timelines

  • Acknowledgment: within 24 hours of receiving a formal report.
  • Urgent security action: within 24 to 48 hours for severe malware, phishing, or statutory takedown notices.
  • Resolution: within a maximum of 15 days of receipt.

7. What We Cannot Do

  • YonoappDex is an informational directory. We do not create or operate the apps listed.
  • We cannot recover lost money, unfreeze third-party accounts, or force a developer to process a withdrawal.
